interpretation: Regional flows do not fall with the observed tissue-resistance doubling. Most sampled beds rise approximately 1.06x and both kidneys rise approximately 1.295x.
p1_decision: Do not impose renal or hepatosplanchnic flow targets from the Stage 7 literature before identifying the existing circuit compensation. Preserve proportional/default behavior and defer structural flow-target implementation.
limitations: Values are stabilized endpoint medians, not full-cycle flow distributions.
Bone and fat tissue resistances are logged by the engine but have no separately requested vascular inflow in the Stage 6 output.
The direct patient uses the Stage 6 Standard-body definition; this is a mechanism diagnostic, not population validation.
